passages.text: Then the LORD said to Abram, “Leave your country, your kindred, and your father’s household, and go to the land I will show you.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Abram.
Abram was the son of Terah.
The LORD said, “Leave your country.
Leave your relatives.
Leave your father’s household.
Go to the land I will show you.”
passages.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָ֔ם לֶךְ־ לְךָ֛ מֵאַרְצְךָ֥ וּמִמּֽוֹלַדְתְּךָ֖ וּמִבֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑יךָ אֶל־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַרְאֶֽךָּ׃

passages.text: I will make you into a great nation, and I will bless you; I will make your name great, so that you will be a blessing.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God promised Abram important things.
God said, “I will make you into a great nation.
I will bless you.
I will make your name great.
You will be a blessing.”
passages.original: וְאֶֽעֶשְׂךָ֙ לְג֣וֹי גָּד֔וֹל וַאֲבָ֣רֶכְךָ֔ וַאֲגַדְּלָ֖ה שְׁמֶ֑ךָ וֶהְיֵ֖ה בְּרָכָֽה׃

passages.text: I will bless those who bless you and curse those who curse you; and all the families of the earth will be blessed through you.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Abram.
God said, “I will bless everyone who blesses you.
I will curse everyone who curses you.
All the families on earth will receive blessing through you.”
passages.original: וַאֲבָֽרֲכָה֙ מְבָ֣רְכֶ֔יךָ וּמְקַלֶּלְךָ֖ אָאֹ֑ר וְנִבְרְכ֣וּ בְךָ֔ כֹּ֖ל מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָאֲדָמָֽה׃

passages.text: So Abram departed, as the LORD had directed him, and Lot went with him. Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man whom the LORD spoke to.
The LORD directed Abram to leave his home.
Abram obeyed the LORD.
Abram departed from Haran.
Lot went with Abram.
Abram was seventy-five years old when he left Haran.
passages.original: וַיֵּ֣לֶךְ אַבְרָ֗ם כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר דִּבֶּ֤ר אֵלָיו֙ יְהוָ֔ה וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ אִתּ֖וֹ ל֑וֹט וְאַבְרָ֗ם בֶּן־ חָמֵ֤שׁ שָׁנִים֙ וְשִׁבְעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֔ה בְּצֵאת֖וֹ מֵחָרָֽן׃

passages.text: And Abram took his wife Sarai, his nephew Lot, and all the possessions and people they had acquired in Haran, and set out for the land of Canaan. When they came to the land of Canaan, Abram traveled through the land as far as the site of the Oak of Moreh at Shechem. And at that time the Canaanites were in the land.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
Abram took his wife Sarai.
Abram took his nephew Lot.
Abram took all the possessions they had gained in Haran.
Abram took all the people they had acquired in Haran.
Abram and his group left Haran.
They set out for the land of Canaan.
They arrived in the land of Canaan.
Abram traveled through the land.
He went as far as the place called Shechem.
He reached the Oak of Moreh at Shechem.
At that time, the Canaanites lived in the land.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֣ח אַבְרָם֩ אֶת־ שָׂרַ֨י אִשְׁתּ֜וֹ וְאֶת־ ל֣וֹט בֶּן־ אָחִ֗יו וְאֶת־ כָּל־ רְכוּשָׁם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָכָ֔שׁוּ וְאֶת־ הַנֶּ֖פֶשׁ אֲשֶׁר־ עָשׂ֣וּ בְחָרָ֑ן וַיֵּצְא֗וּ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ אַ֣רְצָה כְּנַ֔עַן וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ אַ֥רְצָה כְּנָֽעַן׃ וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ר אַבְרָם֙ בָּאָ֔רֶץ עַ֚ד מְק֣וֹם שְׁכֶ֔ם עַ֖ד אֵל֣וֹן מוֹרֶ֑ה וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֖י אָ֥ז בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD appeared to Abram and said, “I will give this land to your offspring.” So Abram built an altar there to the LORD, who had appeared to him.
passages.sermon:
The LORD appeared to Abram.
The LORD spoke to Abram.
The LORD said, “I will give this land to your offspring.”
Abram built an altar there.
Abram built the altar for the LORD.
The LORD had appeared to Abram.
passages.original: וַיֵּרָ֤א יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ אַבְרָ֔ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְזַ֨רְעֲךָ֔ אֶתֵּ֖ן אֶת־ הָאָ֣רֶץ הַזֹּ֑את וַיִּ֤בֶן שָׁם֙ מִזְבֵּ֔חַ לַיהוָ֖ה הַנִּרְאֶ֥ה אֵלָֽיו׃

passages.text: From there Abram moved on to the hill country east of Bethel and pitched his tent, with Bethel to the west and Ai to the east. There he built an altar to the LORD, and he called on the name of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
Abram left the place where he was.
He went to the hill country east of Bethel.
Abram set up his tent there.
Bethel was to the west of him.
Ai was to the east of him.
Abram built an altar there.
He built the altar for the LORD.
Abram called on the name of the LORD.
passages.original: וַיַּעְתֵּ֨ק מִשָּׁ֜ם הָהָ֗רָה מִקֶּ֛דֶם לְבֵֽית־ אֵ֖ל וַיֵּ֣ט אָהֳלֹ֑ה בֵּֽית־ אֵ֤ל מִיָּם֙ וְהָעַ֣י מִקֶּ֔דֶם וַיִּֽבֶן־ שָׁ֤ם מִזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לַֽיהוָ֔ה וַיִּקְרָ֖א בְּשֵׁ֥ם יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: And Abram journeyed on toward the Negev.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
Abram traveled.
He continued his journey.
He went toward the Negev.

passages.text: Now there was a famine in the land. So Abram went down to Egypt to live there for a while because the famine was severe.
passages.sermon:
Abram was a man chosen by God.
There was a famine in the land.
The famine was very severe.
Abram went down to Egypt.
He went there to live for a while.
He did this because the famine was severe in the land.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י רָעָ֖ב בָּאָ֑רֶץ וַיֵּ֨רֶד אַבְרָ֤ם מִצְרַ֙יְמָה֙ לָג֣וּר שָׁ֔ם כִּֽי־ כָבֵ֥ד הָרָעָ֖ב בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: As he was about to enter Egypt, he said to his wife Sarai, “Look, I know that you are a beautiful woman, and when the Egyptians see you, they will say, ‘This is his wife.’ Then they will kill me but will let you live.
passages.sermon:
Abram was Sarai’s husband.
Abram was about to enter Egypt.
Abram spoke to Sarai.
Abram said, “Look, I know something.”
Abram said, “You are a beautiful woman.”
Abram said, “The Egyptians will see you.”
Abram said, “They will say, ‘This is his wife.’”
Abram said, “They will kill me.”
Abram said, “They will let you live.”
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר הִקְרִ֖יב לָב֣וֹא מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיֹּ֙אמֶר֙ אֶל־ שָׂרַ֣י אִשְׁתּ֔וֹ הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א יָדַ֔עְתִּי כִּ֛י אִשָּׁ֥ה יְפַת־ מַרְאֶ֖ה אָֽתְּ׃ וְהָיָ֗ה כִּֽי־ יִרְא֤וּ אֹתָךְ֙ הַמִּצְרִ֔ים וְאָמְר֖וּ אִשְׁתּ֣וֹ זֹ֑את וְהָרְג֥וּ אֹתִ֖י וְאֹתָ֥ךְ יְחַיּֽוּ׃

passages.text: Please say you are my sister, so that I will be treated well for your sake, and on account of you my life will be spared.”
passages.sermon:
Abram was Sarai’s husband.
Abram spoke to Sarai.
Abram said, “Please say you are my sister.
If you say this, people will treat me well because of you.
Because of you, my life will be spared.”
passages.original: אִמְרִי־ נָ֖א אֲחֹ֣תִי אָ֑תְּ לְמַ֙עַן֙ יִֽיטַב־ לִ֣י בַעֲבוּרֵ֔ךְ וְחָיְתָ֥ה נַפְשִׁ֖י בִּגְלָלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: So when Abram entered Egypt, the Egyptians saw that the woman was very beautiful.
passages.sermon:
Abram entered Egypt.
The Egyptians saw the woman.
The woman was very beautiful.
The Egyptians noticed her beauty.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֕י כְּב֥וֹא אַבְרָ֖ם מִצְרָ֑יְמָה וַיִּרְא֤וּ הַמִּצְרִים֙ אֶת־ הָ֣אִשָּׁ֔ה כִּֽי־ יָפָ֥ה הִ֖וא מְאֹֽד׃

passages.text: When Pharaoh’s officials saw Sarai, they commended her to him, and she was taken into the palace of Pharaoh.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh ruled Egypt.
Pharaoh had officials who served him.
Abram and his wife Sarai traveled to Egypt.
Sarai was Abram’s wife.
Sarai was very beautiful.
Pharaoh’s officials saw Sarai.
The officials noticed her beauty.
The officials praised Sarai to Pharaoh.
Pharaoh heard about Sarai from his officials.
Pharaoh’s men took Sarai.
They brought Sarai into Pharaoh’s palace.
passages.original: וַיִּרְא֤וּ אֹתָהּ֙ שָׂרֵ֣י פַרְעֹ֔ה וַיְהַֽלְל֥וּ אֹתָ֖הּ אֶל־ פַּרְעֹ֑ה וַתֻּקַּ֥ח הָאִשָּׁ֖ה בֵּ֥ית פַּרְעֹֽה׃

passages.text: He treated Abram well on her account, and Abram acquired sheep and cattle, male and female donkeys, menservants and maidservants, and camels.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh treated Abram well because of Sarai.
Abram received many gifts.
He received sheep.
He received cattle.
He received male donkeys.
He received female donkeys.
He received male servants.
He received female servants.
He received camels.
passages.original: וּלְאַבְרָ֥ם הֵיטִ֖יב בַּעֲבוּרָ֑הּ וַֽיְהִי־ ל֤וֹ צֹאן־ וּבָקָר֙ וַחֲמֹרִ֔ים וַעֲבָדִים֙ וּשְׁפָחֹ֔ת וַאֲתֹנֹ֖ת וּגְמַלִּֽים׃

passages.text: The LORD, however, afflicted Pharaoh and his household with severe plagues because of Abram’s wife Sarai.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is God.
The LORD acted with power.
The LORD sent severe plagues.
The LORD afflicted Pharaoh.
The LORD afflicted Pharaoh’s household.
The LORD did this because of Sarai.
Sarai was Abram’s wife.
passages.original: וַיְנַגַּ֨ע יְהוָ֧ה׀ אֶת־ פַּרְעֹ֛ה נְגָעִ֥ים גְּדֹלִ֖ים וְאֶת־ בֵּית֑וֹ עַל־ דְּבַ֥ר שָׂרַ֖י אֵ֥שֶׁת אַבְרָֽם׃

passages.text: So Pharaoh summoned Abram and asked, “What have you done to me? Why didn’t you tell me she was your wife?
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh called Abram to come to him.
Pharaoh spoke to Abram.
Pharaoh said, “What have you done to me?”
Pharaoh asked Abram, “Why did you not tell me she was your wife?”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֤א פַרְעֹה֙ לְאַבְרָ֔ם וַיֹּ֕אמֶר מַה־ זֹּ֖את עָשִׂ֣יתָ לִּ֑י לָ֚מָּה לֹא־ הִגַּ֣דְתָּ לִּ֔י כִּ֥י אִשְׁתְּךָ֖ הִֽוא׃

passages.text: Why did you say, ‘She is my sister,’ so that I took her as my wife? Now then, here is your wife. Take her and go!”
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh spoke to Abram.
Pharaoh asked Abram a question.
Pharaoh said, "Why did you say, 'She is my sister'?"
Pharaoh said, "I took her as my wife because of what you said."
Pharaoh said, "Now here is your wife."
Pharaoh said, "Take her and go."
passages.original: לָמָ֤ה אָמַ֙רְתָּ֙ אֲחֹ֣תִי הִ֔וא וָאֶקַּ֥ח אֹתָ֛הּ לִ֖י לְאִשָּׁ֑ה וְעַתָּ֕ה הִנֵּ֥ה אִשְׁתְּךָ֖ קַ֥ח וָלֵֽךְ׃

passages.text: Then Pharaoh gave his men orders concerning Abram, and they sent him away with his wife and all his possessions.
passages.sermon:
Pharaoh was the king of Egypt.
Pharaoh gave orders to his men about Abram.
Pharaoh’s men acted on his command.
They sent Abram away from Egypt.
They sent Abram’s wife with him.
They sent all of Abram’s possessions with him.
passages.original: וַיְצַ֥ו עָלָ֛יו פַּרְעֹ֖ה אֲנָשִׁ֑ים וַֽיְשַׁלְּח֥וּ אֹת֛וֹ וְאֶת־ אִשְׁתּ֖וֹ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לֽוֹ׃
